newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal increases share buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal increases share buyback plan.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said on Monday its board of directors voted to increase the number of common shares for repurchase by 50 million shares.

The board also voted to seek shareholder approval at the April 28 annual meeting to increase the number of authorized common shares to one billion from 500 million, the company said. If approved, the additional shares would be available for stock splits, acquisitions and other purchase, it said.
Since 1985, the board has authorized the repurchase of 150 million shares. As of November 30, AlliedSignal had repurchased about 148 million shares, the company said.
AlliedSignal has about 283 milion shares outstanding.
